subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress/checklist draft while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses progress mode to a one-line activity summary, and adding full retention plus checklist semantics creates a new public config and lifecycle policy.

options.title: Sponsor scoped preserve mode
options.body: Approve a Telegram-owned default-off option after defining retained content, checklist semantics, and privacy/notification expectations.

options.title: Keep collapse summary only
options.body: Treat the current one-line retained summary as the intended completion behavior and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track this under a broader cross-channel progress-card API before adding Telegram-only config.

recommendation.title: Sponsor scoped preserve mode
recommendation.body: Approve a Telegram-owned default-off option after defining retained content, checklist semantics, and privacy/notification expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Telegram collapse-summary lifecycle this request would extend or replace.
